## Standards

**1 hard breach; no additional baseline-smell findings.**

- **Required party fields remain optional** — `exposed/src/lib/domain/repositories/parliament_api.rs:35–36,46–58`; delayed rejection at `domain/models/member_ingestion.rs:267–275`. PR comment [#4159977445](https://github.com/johnnylarner/exposed/pull/13#discussion_r4159977445) explicitly targeted the original source profile’s `party_id` and `party_name`: “These shouldn’t be optional.” Renaming that profile to `MemberObservation` and moving it into the source port retains the questioned behavior. `MemberObservation::new` accepts absent party data; Fetch publishes it, and Load rejects it later. The new `MissingParty` integration scenario confirms this. Making only `ParliamentMember` nonnullable does not satisfy the targeted feedback.

  Require party fields in the source-port profile and reject missing values during construction. Update the capture contract and documentation consistently; the newly added nullable-source exception was not authorized by the PR feedback.

The database/repository consolidation, configuration pattern, private fields, decoding simplification and removal of count summaries otherwise follow the supplied instructions. Tests were not rerun.
